verdict.rationale: Smooth documents programmatic session and task management through REST endpoints: creating persistent browser sessions, listing tasks, cancelling running tasks, and sending close or other actions to sessions. Nothing in the evidence shows running many browser sessions concurrently or any published concurrency limits, and sessions are described only as sequential tasks within a single browser instance. missing for 10: documented concurrent or parallel session fleet support, documented concurrency limits or quotas, independent corroboration of running sessions at scale.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can run a fleet of concurrent browser sessions with documented concurrency limits and programmatic session management

citations.quote: You can run AI-powered tasks, create interactive browser sessions, and extend agent capabilities with custom tools.
